; Switch the meeting-note calendar button between its stock action and AppLoad.
; Only the non-secret launcher preference is read. No running backend is needed.
VERSION 3.27.3.0

AFFECT [[3134726245001688449]]
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0
    TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property ~&6503679477&~ nextcloudCalendarEnabled: ~&6504329801&~
            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 1000
                ~&233743626668842&~: ~&6504329801&~
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&6504329801&~
                ~&10321248157061752881&~: ~&6504329801&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    ~&197102514&~ request =  new  XMLHttpRequest();
                    request.onreadystatechange = function() {
                        ~&5972376&~ (request.readyState !== 4) { ~&7083121450889&~; }
                        try {
                            ~&197102514&~ ~&7713561876955258&~ = ~&6502785411&~.parse(request.responseText);
                            ~&5972376&~ (~&7083223278816&~ ~&7713561876955258&~.~&233726547792244&~ === "boolean") {
                                ~&6504254477&~.nextcloudCalendarEnabled = ~&7713561876955258&~.~&233726547792244&~;
                            }
                        } catch (~&214625091795&~) { }
                    };
                    request.~&6504147419&~("GET", "file:///home/root/.local/share/nextcloud-calendar/launcher.json");
                    request.~&6504279475&~();
                }
            }
        }
        REBUILD [[12473595850146141341]]
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            INSERT STREAM / ~&6504254477&~.nextcloudCalendarEnabled ? [~&"233737316206498&~] : ( /
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT STREAM / ) /
        END REBUILD
        REBUILD [[214638027133]]
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            INSERT STREAM / ~&6504254477&~.nextcloudCalendarEnabled ? ~&6504117156&~ : ( /
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT STREAM / ) /
        END REBUILD
        REBUILD [[5336234142035948531]]
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM / { /
            INSERT {
                ~&5972376&~ (~&6504254477&~.nextcloudCalendarEnabled) {
                    AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication("org.remarkable.nextcloudcalendar", [], {}, ~&214625660372&~);
                    ~&7083121450889&~;
                }
            }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
